items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Hank Jones, Ellis Larkins -- Those are piano players... And they know how if you're playing together, especially with a guitar, to keep out of each other's way.

ctx.x: How did things work with alternating groups? Did you play on the same stage?

Oh yeah, the 3 Deuces was a small place. I don't think you could get but 80 people in there. It was very small. Maybe a hundred, I guess. Then it would be jam packed. It was a small place but it was packed every night. 'Cause they had good music. Ben Webster had a good group. I said he had 4 pieces, but he must have had 5. Yeah, he had 5, because he had to have a piano. A lot of fellas, like me, I don't need a piano. I mean, I can go without one you know. A piano is a clash there if the guy ain't together... And…
How would you compare those guys to Art Tatum?
